source.userMetadataNote: The public Geofabrik file omits OSM user names, user IDs, and changeset IDs. It includes object identifiers, versions, timestamps, tags and geometry.
source.sourceStorage: data/raw/osm/ is ignored by Git; the source PBF and checksum file are not committed.

groundAssumption.bridge: absent or exactly 'no' accepted; otherwise exclude whole way
groundAssumption.tunnel: absent or exactly 'no' accepted; otherwise exclude whole way
groundAssumption.covered: absent or exactly 'no' accepted; otherwise exclude whole way
groundAssumption.layer: absent or strict integer zero accepted; all others excluded
groundAssumption.tagAbsence: visual ground assumption only, not verified elevation

policies.areaSurfacePolicy: exclude area=yes and any area:highway tag

buffer.widthMeaning: estimated full display width; radius is width/2
buffer.quantization: centerline coordinates quantized to configured millimetres before buffering

policies.clip: buffered polygons clipped to exact AOI; centerline parts are also clipped for inspection
policies.triangulation: fixed TerrainGrid triangles (NW,SW,NE) and (NE,SW,SE); constrained Delaunay per clipped triangle
policies.float32SliverPolicy: Cull triangles only when fewer than three distinct [x,z] coordinates remain after Float32 conversion; report the count and omitted area, bounded to 2e-5 m2 for the expanded current_2km network.

coverage.note: Mapped OSM counts do not establish completeness; overall AOI remains pending.
